```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03", "04"),
  packages = c("here", "dplyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "flexsurv", "survival"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r extract-ic-tables, include=FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# Distribution selection rule (04_parametric_survival_analysis.R, issue #153):
# the OS and PFS distributions are selected JOINTLY as the pair with the lowest
# combined AIC among all pairs whose population-averaged curves satisfy
# OS >= PFS for control and every economic biomarker subgroup at every weekly
# time point of the 10-year horizon. The selected distributions therefore need
# not be the lowest-AIC distribution of each endpoint taken on its own. The
# selected pair and the full pair audit are read from `models`, never
# hard-coded.
# =============================================================================
selected_os  <- models$best_fit$os_distribution
selected_pfs <- models$best_fit$pfs_distribution
ordered_selection <- models$ordered_selection
pairs <- ordered_selection$pairs

os_ic <- models$full$os_ic %>%
  filter(!is.na(AIC)) %>%
  arrange(AIC) %>%
  mutate(
    AIC_rank = rank(AIC),
    BIC_rank = rank(BIC),
    delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    delta_BIC = BIC - min(BIC),
    Selected = Distribution == selected_os
  )

pfs_ic <- models$full$pfs_ic %>%
  filter(!is.na(AIC)) %>%
  arrange(AIC) %>%
  mutate(
    AIC_rank = rank(AIC),
    BIC_rank = rank(BIC),
    delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    delta_BIC = BIC - min(BIC),
    Selected = Distribution == selected_pfs
  )

stopifnot(sum(os_ic$Selected) == 1, sum(pfs_ic$Selected) == 1)

lowest_aic_os  <- os_ic$Distribution[1]
lowest_aic_pfs <- pfs_ic$Distribution[1]
selected_row_os  <- which(os_ic$Selected)
selected_row_pfs <- which(pfs_ic$Selected)

cat("OS distributions fitted:", nrow(os_ic), "\n")
cat("PFS distributions fitted:", nrow(pfs_ic), "\n")
cat("Selected (ordering-constrained) pair: OS", selected_os, "/ PFS", selected_pfs, "\n")
cat("Lowest marginal AIC: OS", lowest_aic_os, "/ PFS", lowest_aic_pfs, "\n")
cat("Ordering-constraint AIC penalty:", round(ordered_selection$ic_penalty, 2), "\n")
```

## Overall Survival

```{r display-os-table}
os_display <- os_ic %>%
  mutate(
    AIC = sprintf("%.2f", AIC),
    BIC = sprintf("%.2f", BIC),
    delta_AIC = sprintf("%.2f", delta_AIC),
    delta_BIC = sprintf("%.2f", delta_BIC),
    Selected = ifelse(Selected, "Yes", "")
  ) %>%
  select(Distribution, AIC, delta_AIC, BIC, delta_BIC, AIC_rank, Selected)

kable(os_display,
      caption = "Overall survival: parametric distribution comparison (joint economic model), ordered by marginal AIC",
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Distribution", "AIC", "Delta AIC", "BIC", "Delta BIC", "AIC Rank", "Selected"),
      align = c("l", rep("r", 5), "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  row_spec(selected_row_os, bold = TRUE, background = "#e8f5e9")
```

## Progression-Free Survival

```{r display-pfs-table}
pfs_display <- pfs_ic %>%
  mutate(
    AIC = sprintf("%.2f", AIC),
    BIC = sprintf("%.2f", BIC),
    delta_AIC = sprintf("%.2f", delta_AIC),
    delta_BIC = sprintf("%.2f", delta_BIC),
    Selected = ifelse(Selected, "Yes", "")
  ) %>%
  select(Distribution, AIC, delta_AIC, BIC, delta_BIC, AIC_rank, Selected)

kable(pfs_display,
      caption = "Progression-free survival: parametric distribution comparison (joint economic model), ordered by marginal AIC",
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Distribution", "AIC", "Delta AIC", "BIC", "Delta BIC", "AIC Rank", "Selected"),
      align = c("l", rep("r", 5), "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  row_spec(selected_row_pfs, bold = TRUE, background = "#e8f5e9")
```

## Joint (OS, PFS) Pair Selection Under the Ordering Constraint

```{r display-pair-audit}
n_pairs_show <- min(12, nrow(pairs))
selected_pair_idx <- which(pairs$os_distribution == selected_os &
                             pairs$pfs_distribution == selected_pfs)
show_idx <- sort(unique(c(seq_len(n_pairs_show), selected_pair_idx)))

pairs_display <- pairs[show_idx, ] %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = show_idx,
    combined_ic = sprintf("%.2f", combined_ic),
    delta_combined = sprintf("%.2f", pairs$combined_ic[show_idx] - min(pairs$combined_ic)),
    Ordered = ifelse(ordered, "Yes", "No"),
    n_violations = ifelse(is.na(n_violations), "--", as.character(n_violations)),
    max_gap = ifelse(is.finite(max_pfs_minus_os), sprintf("%.4f", max_pfs_minus_os), "--"),
    Selected = ifelse(os_distribution == selected_os & pfs_distribution == selected_pfs, "Yes", "")
  ) %>%
  select(Rank, os_distribution, pfs_distribution, combined_ic, delta_combined,
         Ordered, n_violations, max_gap, Selected)

kable(pairs_display,
      caption = sprintf("Candidate (OS, PFS) distribution pairs ordered by combined AIC (top %d of %d pairs shown, plus the selected pair)",
                        n_pairs_show, nrow(pairs)),
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Rank", "OS distribution", "PFS distribution", "Combined AIC",
                    "Delta combined AIC", "OS >= PFS", "Violating time points",
                    "Max PFS - OS", "Selected"),
      align = c("r", "l", "l", "r", "r", "c", "r", "r", "c"),
      row.names = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 11) %>%
  row_spec(which(pairs_display$Selected == "Yes"), bold = TRUE, background = "#e8f5e9") %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "OS >= PFS: whether the population-averaged OS curve is at least the PFS curve for control and every economic biomarker subgroup at every weekly time point of the model horizon.",
      "Violating time points: number of (subgroup, week) points at which PFS exceeds OS; Max PFS - OS: the largest such exceedance.",
      "The selected pair is the lowest combined-AIC pair with OS >= PFS everywhere."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r combined-summary}
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Endpoint = c("Overall survival", "Progression-free survival"),
  `Selected distribution` = c(selected_os, selected_pfs),
  `AIC (selected)` = sprintf("%.2f", c(os_ic$AIC[selected_row_os], pfs_ic$AIC[selected_row_pfs])),
  `Lowest marginal AIC` = c(lowest_aic_os, lowest_aic_pfs),
  `AIC (lowest)` = sprintf("%.2f", c(os_ic$AIC[1], pfs_ic$AIC[1])),
  `Delta AIC vs lowest` = sprintf("%.2f", c(os_ic$delta_AIC[selected_row_os], pfs_ic$delta_AIC[selected_row_pfs])),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(summary_df,
      caption = "Table S3: Summary of parametric distribution selection",
      format = "html") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Models fitted to the joint economic model specification: Surv ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp*Rx + tmb_braf*Rx.",
      sprintf("Selection rule: OS and PFS distributions are chosen jointly as the pair with the lowest combined AIC among pairs whose population-averaged curves satisfy OS >= PFS for every subgroup at every weekly time point. Selected: OS %s, PFS %s; combined AIC %.2f, which is %.2f AIC above the unconstrained minimum (OS %s, PFS %s).",
              selected_os, selected_pfs, models$best_fit$combined_aic,
              ordered_selection$ic_penalty, lowest_aic_os, lowest_aic_pfs),
      "Delta AIC/BIC in the endpoint tables = difference from the lowest-AIC (BIC) distribution for that endpoint. Distributions with Delta AIC > 10 have essentially no empirical support.",
      "Candidate distributions: exponential, Weibull, Weibull PH, log-logistic, log-normal, gamma, Gompertz, generalized gamma, generalized F."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("outputs", "tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

combined_ic <- rbind(
  os_ic %>% mutate(Endpoint = "OS"),
  pfs_ic %>% mutate(Endpoint = "PFS")
)

write.csv(combined_ic, file = here("outputs", "tables", "table_s3.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pairs %>% mutate(Selected = os_distribution == selected_os & pfs_distribution == selected_pfs),
          file = here("outputs", "tables", "table_s3_pairs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Tables saved to:", here("outputs", "tables", "table_s3.csv"), "and",
    here("outputs", "tables", "table_s3_pairs.csv"), "\n")
```

Table S3 has been saved to `outputs/tables/table_s3.csv`; the joint pair audit is in `outputs/tables/table_s3_pairs.csv`.
